description: OpenClaw's retired npm names, installed for real so the alias route is not untestable by assumption.
why: The retired names were recorded as coverable only by a fixture, on the reasoning that nothing installs them any more. Both packages are still on npm, so the reasoning was wrong and this scenario is the correction: a real install, producing the real rows, for the identifiers a fleet that never upgraded still reports.
known_gaps: The npm names only. The macOS side of this lineage is 57-clawdbot-era, which installs the Clawdbot-era app and proves its bundle id.
